content_html:
Traveling to Cusco and visiting the world wonder of Machu Picchu is a unique experience. However, before planning your itinerary, it is essential to know which documents, tickets, and permits you need to enter without any issues.

In this updated 2026 guide, you will find all the requirements explained step by step.

Mandatory Documents to Enter Peru

Before thinking about Machu Picchu, you need to meet the requirements to enter the country.

Valid Passport

Required for foreign tourists.
A minimum validity of 6 months is recommended.
It must be in good physical condition.

National Identity Document (DNI)

Only for Peruvian citizens.
Citizens from some South American countries may also enter with their national ID, depending on current agreements.

Andean Migration Card (TAM)

Migration registration is currently digital. You will receive an entry stamp or electronic migration record upon arrival in the country. It is important to keep this information for your departure.

Do I Need a Visa to Travel to Cusco?

It depends on your nationality. Many countries in the Americas and Europe do not require a visa for short tourist stays (up to 90 days). Always verify with the Peruvian consulate in your country before traveling.

Machu Picchu Entrance Ticket

To visit Machu Picchu, you must purchase an official entrance ticket in advance.

Daily visitor capacity is limited. During high season (May to October), tickets may sell out months in advance.

Special Permits (If You Are Trekking)

If you plan to do the famous:

Inca Trail

You will need an additional special permit, as access is regulated and limited per day. Only authorized agencies can arrange these permits.

Permits usually sell out 4 to 6 months in advance.

Cusco Tourist Ticket

You will need the Cusco Tourist Ticket (BTC), which grants access to several archaeological sites and museums.

Documents You Must Carry on the Day of Your Visit

To enter Machu Picchu, you need to present:

Original passport or DNI
Printed or digital entrance ticket
Train ticket (if applicable)
Valid student ID (if applying for discount)

At our agency, we understand that organizing a trip to Cusco and Machu Picchu can seem complex due to permits, tickets, and requirements that are updated every year.
